scope: Local implementation, documentation, mocked API contracts, and authorization behavior only.

acceptance.notes: Design records all six use cases, permissions/data boundaries, callbacks, throttling, identity mapping, retries, and fallbacks. OAuth login, encrypted HTTP callbacks, directory sync, and admin retry endpoints are implemented. Official contracts were checked against DingTalk Open Platform documentation.

Local mocks cover code exchange, state validation, callback encryption, batch event IDs, department transfer, offboarding revocation, duplicate events, and retry/error behavior. No authorized DingTalk test organization or credentials were available, so live User/Department sync, userId mapping, callback delivery, and tenant permission validation were not performed.

checks.result: passed with a one-time DATABASE_URL placeholder; no database connection was made

not_performed: Live DingTalk OAuth and callback verification against a tenant
required_to_continue: An authorized DingTalk test organization and approved app permissions
AppKey, AppSecret, corpId, callback Token, and callback AESKey injected through the local runtime environment
A publicly reachable HTTPS callback URL for real event delivery
